verdict.rationale: Attaching custom metadata to a job is a fair question for an async transcription API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a custom_metadata or similar request field echoed back in results or webhook payloads. The live session `id` is a Gladia-generated identifier, not user-supplied metadata, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach my own identifiers or metadata to a job and get them back in results and webhook payloads
